scope: H100 run of the original H20 two-dimensional Kovasznay solve campaign: the same 460 source, adapter and snapshot files (H20-expectations.json), frozen data and six formal initialization byte strings (frozen-H20-inputs.json), optimizer budget and acceptance; GL8 native is the candidate in every lane
prepared: 2026-10-13; that submission was cancelled while pending and never ran. This attempt changes only the Slurm job name in the batch configuration; plan, drivers, case wrapper, audit, inputs and runtime are unchanged and hash-checked at start

batch.selection: per backend, the faster of its GPU-qualified default/compiled variants (qualification at development seed 361902) runs the solves
batch.execution: one fresh process per case, no retries, per-case timeouts from the plan; science deadline 9,000 s after start; audit and archive afterwards
batch.node: one ACC node, four H100 lanes; matched seed and physical GPU for every pair

primary_analysis: audit_h20.py, unchanged: NumPy recheck of qualification gradients (atol 2e-12, rtol 2e-11), complete CPU scalar-coordinate-AD recheck of every accepted checkpoint, and per lane the paired geometric mean of baseline/gl8_native setup-plus-optimization time over jointly accepted seeds

supplementary_analysis.reader: read_h20_h100_supplement.py, registered before the run and applied to the batch outputs afterwards
statistics: optimization-only and per-evaluation paired geometric means for the same pairs
Adam/L-BFGS phase cost per evaluation for every solve
compiler-cache state: earlier cases of the same backend and compile mode on the lane

expectations.note: expectations, not gates; no numeric predictions; H20 ratios are reported beside the H100 ones and never pooled
expectations.optimization: At 2,048 points the H100 solve-scale study found a fixed L-BFGS cost of 5.9-7.1 ms per evaluation beyond the gradient. GL8's optimization-time advantage is therefore expected to compress toward 1 against baselines whose full gradient costs well under that, and to persist against baselines whose gradient costs several milliseconds or more.
expectations.setup: Setup-plus-optimization ratios also contain compile and setup time, which depends on compiler-cache state and therefore on queue order

not_claimed: no new method, no change to the H20 results, no 3D or C36 statement
